title: HBM Warfare
description: A multiplayer modpack that includes flans compatibility with hbm mod
body:
At its core, its HBM, A couple tech mods, a shop to assist with progression, and Flans with a lot of crafttweaker entries to make tables and parts use HBM resources. Its my personal hbm modpack which is supposed to encourage fighting using a simple economy accessable through the quest book. 

If you wish to disable the shop and its functions, simply disable BetterQuesting and remove its associated crafttweaker entries found at \scripts\bq_extras.zs\

I do also suggest adding [Pam's BrewCraft](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pams-brewcraft/files/2997188) and [Pam's Cookables](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pams-cookables/files/2504109) to your instance. I cannot include them in the modpack installation because of their licenses.
